{{Compendium/Extract}}
Honeyvore Bears are powerful animals that inhabit the wildernesses of [[Hyrule]] during the [[Era of the Wilds]]. They can be found in areas throughout Hyrule Kingdom, but are particularly common in the [[Akkala Highlands]] and the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. Honeyvore Bears have primarily brown fur, with golden-brown muzzles. They are known to have a strong taste for [[Courser Bee Honey]].<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2">{{Cite|This king among animals is dangerous game for even the most seasoned hunters. They'll attack anyone who wanders into their territory regardless of the wanderer's weaponry. As their name implies, they have a natural love of honey. Extreme caution is advised when you spot one, but if you're sneaky enough and maybe just a little bit crazy... you just may be able to ride one.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref>

Honeyvore Bears are highly territorial animals, and will attack anyone who crosses into their territories.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/><ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 163}}</ref> However, they can also be ridden and tamed like a [[Horse]] if [[Link]] uses [[Stealth]] to sneak up on them.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/><ref>{{Cite Magazine/NM|quote= If you distract its attention and sneak up, you might be able to ride it.|date= 2021 Winter|page= 16}}</ref> If Link rides a Honeyvore Bear to a [[Stable]], though, the owner will refuse to register it.<ref>{{Cite|Not a problem. Let me just— Oh, for the love of Hylia... That's not a horse! We only board horses here, stranger. No exceptions.|Tasseren|BotW}}</ref> [[Bokoblin]]s can also be found riding Honeyvore Bears in certain locations, such as in the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. When killed, they drop [[Raw Meat]] and [[Raw Prime Meat]].

==Trivia==
* Honeyvore Bears are one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], the [[Lord of the Mountain]], the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Stalhorse]], and the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]].
** Of these mounts, the Honeyvore Bear is is one of six that cannot be registered at a Stable.
